build_grpcio_package: build the grpcio Python package with Cython extensions using python setup.py build
check_linker_need_libatomic: check if the system linker requires libatomic by compiling a C++11 atomic test program
cython_extensions_and_necessity: configure and return Cython extension modules and whether Cython is needed for the build
build_grpcio_with_system_openssl: build the grpcio package using the system OpenSSL installation via GRPC_PYTHON_BUILD_SYSTEM_OPENSSL env var
build_grpcio_with_prebuilt_core: build the grpcio Python layer using prebuilt gRPC Core libraries via GRPC_PYTHON_USE_PREBUILT_GRPC_CORE
